I can't book flights. I can only show them to you. The card above is the $389.40 nonstop, Demo Air DA101. Open it on the site to book it, and sign in there if it asks. The offer expires at 18:30 UTC today. If it lapses, I can search again for a fresh price.

One correction to my earlier message: I said the cheapest flight stops in Chicago. The results don't give the connection city, so I shouldn't have said that.
